messages.content: I only started experimenting with Elixir last weekend, and I cannot build anything useful with it yet.

expected_memories.proposition: User is a beginner with Elixir and cannot yet build useful applications with it.

messages.content: I use Excel pivot tables a few times each month and can handle our standard reporting.

expected_memories.proposition: User has working proficiency with Excel pivot tables for standard reporting.

messages.content: I have designed distributed systems professionally for twelve years and now lead architecture reviews.

expected_memories.proposition: User has twelve years of professional distributed-systems experience and leads architecture reviews.

messages.content: I wrote COBOL early in my career, but I have not used it in fifteen years.

expected_memories.proposition: User has old COBOL experience but has not used it in fifteen years.

messages.content: I can read basic SQL queries, but I still need help whenever joins get complicated.

expected_memories.proposition: User can read basic SQL but needs help with complicated joins.

messages.content: It would be nice to write a novel someday, although I have no plan to start one.

expected_memories.proposition: User may want to write a novel someday but has no current plan.

messages.content: I registered for the October marathon and started a four-day weekly training plan.

expected_memories.proposition: User is committed to running the October marathon and follows a four-day weekly training plan.

messages.content: If my partner gets the Berlin role, I might consider relocating, but otherwise I am staying here.

expected_memories.proposition: User might consider relocating if their partner gets a role in Berlin.

messages.content: I finished my AWS certification last month; that goal is complete now.

expected_memories.proposition: User completed an AWS certification last month.

messages.content: Our quarterly target is to cut API latency by twenty percent, and I own the migration work.

expected_memories.proposition: User owns migration work for an active quarterly goal to reduce API latency by twenty percent.

messages.content: For the next two days we have to refresh the cache manually every hour until the patch ships.

expected_memories.proposition: User temporarily refreshes the cache manually every hour until a patch ships in two days.

messages.content: Every Friday I reconcile the invoices, export the report, and archive a signed copy.

expected_memories.proposition: User reconciles invoices, exports the report, and archives a signed copy every Friday.

messages.content: Before every production release, I require two approvals and a tested rollback plan.

expected_memories.proposition: User requires two approvals and a tested rollback plan before every production release.

messages.content: Only during annual audit month, I review access permissions weekly; I do not do that the rest of the year.

expected_memories.proposition: User reviews access permissions weekly only during annual audit month.

messages.content: I am staying in Chennai for a conference this week, but I normally live in Kochi.

expected_memories.proposition: User is temporarily staying in Chennai for a conference this week.
User normally lives in Kochi.

messages.content: For this client project only, use a dark theme; outside this project I do not care about the theme.

expected_memories.proposition: User prefers a dark theme only for the current client project.

messages.content: Across every project, always show me dates in ISO 8601 format.

expected_memories.proposition: User consistently prefers dates in ISO 8601 format across projects.

messages.content: I am acting as team lead until Priya returns next month, then I go back to my regular role.

expected_memories.proposition: User is temporarily acting as team lead until Priya returns next month.

messages.content: I use Rust daily at work because the service is written in it, but I do not particularly prefer the language.

expected_memories.proposition: User uses Rust daily at work.

messages.content: I want to learn piano this year, but I have never played an instrument.

expected_memories.proposition: User wants to learn piano this year.

messages.content: Nora is my manager, and our analytics team uses Looker for its standard dashboards.

expected_memories.proposition: Nora is user's manager.
User's analytics team uses Looker for standard dashboards.

messages.content: We use Jira because the company mandates it; for my personal projects I prefer Linear.

expected_memories.proposition: User's company mandates Jira for work.
User prefers Linear for personal projects.
